papers.title: Real-Time Edge AI Camera-Radar Fusion for MOT with YOLOv11 and ByteTrack
papers.venue: International Conference on Machine Learning Technologies (ICMLT)
papers.abstract: Multi-sensor data fusion (MSDF) is a critical research area for Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) and Autonomous Driving. By combining data from complementary sensors such as cameras, radars, and LiDARs, fusion techniques overcome the inherent limitations of individual sensors, significantly reducing uncertainty and increasing perception reliability. This paper focused on a novel, real-time multi-sensor data fusion (MSDF) architecture that collectively optimizes object detection, tracking, and multi-sensor consistent information for ADAS algorithms. In this approach, a YOLOv11n is deployed on a high-performance Hailo AI (8L) accelerator for camera-based detection. The detected results are processed through the ByteTrack algorithm for object tracking, and a K-MD7 24GHz Radar with built-in object tracking is also deployed to track object information. The collected camera and radar data are processed through a tightly coupled fusion module that performs association via the Hungarian algorithm and uses the Maximum Likelihood Estimation(MLE) for state estimation. This coordinated combination of a high-speed vision pipeline and precise radar measurements produces a markedly more robust and consistent perception output compared to single-sensor approaches.
first_author_affiliations: GITAM School of Science. (of GITAM Deemed to be University.)

papers.abstract_zh: 多传感器数据融合（MSDF）是高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）与自动驾驶的关键研究领域。通过融合相机、雷达和LiDAR等互补传感器数据，融合技术克服了单个传感器的固有局限，显著降低不确定性并提高感知可靠性。本文聚焦一种新颖的实时多传感器数据融合（MSDF）架构，该架构针对ADAS算法联合优化目标检测、跟踪与多传感器一致信息。在该方法中，YOLOv11n部署于高性能Hailo AI（8L）加速器以进行基于相机的检测。检测结果经ByteTrack算法处理以实现目标跟踪，同时部署内置目标跟踪的K-MD7 24GHz Radar以跟踪目标信息。采集的相机与雷达数据经紧耦合融合模块处理，该模块通过匈牙利算法进行关联，并使用最大似然估计（MLE）进行状态估计。这种高速视觉流水线与精确雷达测量的协同组合，相比单传感器方法产生了显著更鲁棒且一致的感知输出。

papers.title: Graph Learning-Driven Multi-Vessel Association: Fusing Multimodal Data for Maritime Intelligence
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems
papers.abstract: Ensuring maritime safety and optimizing traffic management in increasingly crowded and complex waterways require effective waterway monitoring. However, current methods struggle with challenges arising from multimodal data, such as dimensional disparities, mismatched target counts, vessel scale variations, occlusions, and asynchronous data streams from systems like the automatic identification system (AIS) and closed-circuit television (CCTV). Traditional multi-vessel association methods often struggle with these complexities, particularly in densely trafficked waterways. To overcome these issues, we propose a graph learning-driven multi-vessel association (named GMvA) method tailored for maritime multimodal data fusion. By integrating AIS and CCTV data, GMvA leverages time series learning and graph neural networks to capture the spatiotemporal features of vessel trajectories effectively. To enhance feature representation, the proposed method incorporates temporal graph attention and spatiotemporal attention, effectively capturing both local and global vessel interactions. Furthermore, a multi-layer perceptron-based uncertainty fusion module computes robust similarity scores, and the Hungarian algorithm is adopted to ensure globally consistent and accurate target matching. To validate the efficacy of our method, we have also constructed a new maritime multimodal dataset (termed MaritimeMmD) for data fusion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GMvA delivers superior accuracy and robustness in multi-vessel association, outperforming existing methods even in challenging scenarios with high vessel density and incomplete or unevenly distributed AIS and CCTV data. The source dataset and code are available athttps://github.com/LouisYxLu/GMvA

papers.summary_zh: 针对AIS与CCTV多模态数据维度差异、目标数量不匹配和异步流导致的多船关联难题，提出图学习驱动的GMvA方法，融合时序学习与图神经网络及时空注意力，结合不确定性融合和匈牙利算法实现鲁棒匹配，并构建MaritimeMmD数据集验证。
papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将GMvA的时序图注意力与不确定性相似度融合模块迁移至视觉–AIS关联，以多传感器轨迹特征为输入、关联标签为监督，调整图节点构建与匈牙利匹配层以处理异步与数量不匹配。
papers.abstract_zh: 在日益拥挤和复杂的水道中保障海上安全并优化交通管理，需要有效的水道监测。然而，当前方法难以应对多模态数据带来的挑战，例如维度差异、目标数量不匹配、船舶尺度变化、遮挡，以及来自自动识别系统（AIS）和闭路电视（CCTV）等系统的异步数据流。传统多船关联方法往往难以处理这些复杂性，尤其是在交通密集的水道中。为克服这些问题，我们提出一种面向海上多模态数据融合的图学习驱动多船关联方法（称为GMvA）。通过整合AIS和CCTV数据，GMvA利用时间序列学习和图神经网络有效捕捉船舶轨迹的时空特征。为增强特征表示，所提方法引入时间图注意力和时空注意力，有效捕捉船舶的局部和全局交互。此外，基于多层感知机的不确定性融合模块计算稳健的相似度得分，并采用匈牙利算法确保全局一致且准确的目标匹配。为验证方法的有效性，我们还构建了一个用于数据融合的新海上多模态数据集（称为MaritimeMmD）。大量实验表明，GMvA在多船关联中具有更高的准确性和鲁棒性，即使在船舶密度高且AIS和CCTV数据不完整或分布不均的挑战性场景中也优于现有方法。源数据集和代码可在https://github.com/LouisYxLu/GMvA获取。

papers.title: calibfusion: Transformer-Based Differentiable Calibration for Radar-Camera Fusion Detection in Water-Surface Environments
papers.abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) Radar--Camera fusion improves perception under adverse illumination and weather, but its performance is sensitive to Radar--Camera extrinsic calibration: residual misalignment biases Radar-to-image projection and degrades cross-modal aggregation for downstream 2D detection. Existing calibration and auto-calibration methods are mainly developed for road and urban scenes with abundant structures and object constraints, whereas water-surface environments feature large textureless regions, sparse and intermittent targets, and wave-/specular-induced Radar clutter, which weakens explicit object-centric matching. We propose CalibFusion, a calibration-conditioned Radar--Camera fusion detector that learns implicit extrinsic refinement end-to-end with the detection objective. CalibFusion builds a multi-frame persistence-aware Radar density representation with intensity weighting and Doppler-guided suppression of fast-varying clutter. A cross-modal transformer interaction module predicts a confidence-gated refinement of the initial extrinsics, which is integrated through a differentiable projection-and-splatting operator to generate calibration-conditioned image-plane Radar features. Experiments on WaterScenes and FLOW show improved fusion-based 2D detection and robustness under synthetic miscalibration, supported by sensitivity analyses and qualitative Radar-to-image overlays. Results on nuScenes indicate that the refinement mechanism transfers beyond water-surface scenarios.
papers.reason: 水面雷达-相机融合与可微标定对海事感知直接相关；跨模态可微投影机制可迁移到雷达-视觉关联，但需适配动态平台。
papers.summary_zh: 针对水面场景雷达-相机外参残余失配导致投影偏差与融合检测退化的问题，提出CalibFusion以检测目标端到端学习隐式外参精化，并构建多帧持久性雷达密度表示与可微投影-溅射融合模块提升2D检测鲁棒性。
papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将置信门控外参精化与可微投影-溅射模块迁移至船舶雷达-视觉或Radar-AIS关联检测中，以多帧持久性雷达密度为输入、检测损失为监督，替换固定外参投影层以增强跨模态特征对齐。
papers.abstract_zh: 毫米波（mmWave）雷达--相机融合可在不利光照与天气下改善感知，但其性能对雷达--相机外参标定敏感：残余失配会使雷达到图像的投影产生偏差，并降低下游2D检测的跨模态聚合效果。现有标定与自标定方法主要面向结构丰富、目标约束充足的道路与城市场景，而水面环境具有大片无纹理区域、稀疏且间歇的目标以及波浪/镜面反射引起的雷达杂波，削弱了显式的以目标为中心的匹配。我们提出CalibFusion，一种标定条件化的雷达--相机融合检测器，以检测目标端到端地学习隐式外参精化。CalibFusion构建多帧持久性感知的雷达密度表示，采用强度加权与多普勒引导的快速变化杂波抑制。跨模态Transformer交互模块预测对初始外参的置信门控精化，并通过可微投影-溅射算子进行整合，以生成标定条件化的图像平面雷达特征。在WaterScenes与FLOW上的实验表明，融合式2D检测得到改善，且在合成失配下具有鲁棒性，并辅以敏感性分析与定性的雷达到图像叠加结果。nuScenes上的结果表明，该精化机制可迁移到水面场景之外。

papers.title: Towards Accurate 3D Object Detection in Adverse Weather by Leveraging 4D Radar for LiDAR Geometry Enhancement
papers.venue: Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: 3D object detection is a critical component of autonomous driving, yet its performance degrades severely in adverse weather due to the degradation of LiDAR point clouds. While existing LiDAR-4D radar fusion methods enhance robustness by incorporating weather-robust 4D radar data, they often depend on well geometric structures from LiDAR and so struggle to effectively exploit radar data in case of degraded LiDAR data. To tackle this challenge, we propose REL, a novel 4D radar-guided LiDAR geometric enhancement framework. It utilizes 4D radar features to dynamically generate virtual LiDAR points, effectively increasing the density of degraded LiDAR data. Moreover, a Position-Guided Cross Attention (PGCA) module is proposed to enhance the feature representation of virtual points, while an Adaptive Feature Fusion (AFF) module is designed to integrate virtual and real LiDAR features. Extensive experiments on the K-Radar and Vod-Fog datasets demonstrate that REL achieves state-of-the-art 3D object detection performance under diverse adverse weather conditions. Notably, REL improves the overall AP3D by 9.3% on K-Radar and boosts the cyclist class by up to 52.9% 3D mAP under the most severe foggy condition on Vod-Fog.
first_author_affiliations: University of Science and Technology Beijing
papers.reason: 车载4D雷达引导LiDAR几何增强与自适应跨模态融合，对多传感器船舶检测有可迁移的融合思路；但场景非海事，迁移需重设计。
papers.summary_zh: 针对恶劣天气下LiDAR点云退化导致3D目标检测性能下降、现有LiDAR-4D Radar融合方法依赖良好LiDAR几何结构的问题，提出REL框架，利用4D Radar特征动态生成虚拟LiDAR点并融合虚实特征以提升检测性能。
papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将4D Radar引导生成虚拟LiDAR点及位置引导交叉注意力、自适应特征融合模块迁移到船舶检测的Radar–AIS或视觉–AIS关联中，用雷达特征补密退化视觉或点云输入，并以关联结果作监督调整融合结构。
papers.abstract_zh: 3D目标检测是自动驾驶的关键组成部分，然而在恶劣天气下，由于LiDAR点云退化，其性能会严重下降。现有LiDAR-4D Radar融合方法通过引入对天气鲁棒的4D Radar数据来增强鲁棒性，但它们往往依赖LiDAR良好的几何结构，因而在LiDAR数据退化时难以有效利用Radar数据。为应对这一挑战，我们提出REL，一种新颖的4D Radar引导的LiDAR几何增强框架。它利用4D Radar特征动态生成虚拟LiDAR点，有效提高退化LiDAR数据的密度。此外，提出位置引导交叉注意力（PGCA）模块以增强虚拟点的特征表示，并设计自适应特征融合（AFF）模块以整合虚拟与真实LiDAR特征。在K-Radar和Vod-Fog数据集上的大量实验表明，REL在多种恶劣天气条件下取得了最先进的3D目标检测性能。值得注意的是，REL在K-Radar上将整体AP3D提升9.3%，并在Vod-Fog最严重雾天条件下将骑行者类别的3D mAP最高提升52.9%。

papers.title: Do Pretrained Backbones Transfer to Physical Sensors? A Systematic Study of Multimodal Initialization Across the Sensor Stack
papers.abstract: Transfer learning from pretrained backbones has become standard practice in multi-sensor computer vision---yet two questions remain open: which pretrained weights transfer best to multi-sensor setups, and can in-domain pretraining outperform off-the-shelf solutions? Frameworks like MultiMAE demonstrate the utility of masked autoencoding in a multi-modal context, but rely entirely on dense, model-derived modalities. It is unclear how robustly these methods translate to real-world applications that use physical sensors, where the aggregation of diverse public datasets for large-scale pretraining inherently introduces modality sparsity. To investigate this systematically, we curate a multi-sensor autonomous driving collection of $2.82M$ images from 16 publicly available datasets, incorporating both physical hardware modalities (RGB, LWIR, NIR, Event) and model-derived modalities (Stereo Depth, Segmentation). We use this collection for in-domain pretraining based on the MultiMAE approach. We adapt MultiMAE's loss formulation to accommodate sparse samples, and study the effect of an enforced encoder bottleneck for modality alignment and of additional losses specific to dense reconstruction (SSIM and FFT). We then systematically compare against common pretrained backbones (ViT, MAE, DINO and MultiMAE) across downstream sensor fusion tasks. We find that MultiMAE is a surprisingly strong out-of-the-box baseline, transferring effectively even to modalities it has never seen, while our targeted modifications yield incremental but consistent improvements on multi-sensor transfer and overall robustness.
papers.reason: 多传感器预训练与模态对齐、阻抗缺失模态方法具体，可迁移至船舶多传感器感知，但需跨域验证。
papers.summary_zh: 该论文构建含282万图像、16个公开数据集的多传感器自动驾驶数据集，用于域内预训练并系统比较ViT、MAE、DINO和MultiMAE在下游传感器融合任务中的迁移效果。
papers.migration_zh: 研究推断：可将多传感器预训练与稀疏样本适配的MultiMAE损失迁移至船舶多传感器融合检测，用Radar、AIS和视觉输入做域内预训练，并在融合编码器中加入模态对齐瓶颈与稠密重建辅助损失。
papers.abstract_zh: 从预训练骨干网络进行迁移学习已成为多传感器计算机视觉中的标准做法——然而两个问题仍未解决：哪些预训练权重最适合迁移到多传感器设置，以及域内预训练能否超越现成方案？像MultiMAE这样的框架展示了掩码自编码在多模态语境中的效用，但完全依赖稠密的、模型导出的模态。目前尚不清楚这些方法能多稳健地迁移到使用物理传感器的真实应用中，在这些应用中，为大规模预训练而聚合多样化的公开数据集会固有地引入模态稀疏性。为系统研究这一问题，我们整理了一个多传感器自动驾驶数据集，包含来自16个公开数据集的$2.82M$张图像，涵盖物理硬件模态（RGB、LWIR、NIR、Event）和模型导出模态（立体深度、分割）。我们使用该数据集基于MultiMAE方法进行域内预训练。我们调整MultiMAE的损失公式以适应稀疏样本，并研究强制编码器瓶颈对模态对齐的影响以及针对稠密重建的额外损失（SSIM和FFT）的影响。然后，我们在下游传感器融合任务中系统性地与常见预训练骨干网络（ViT、MAE、DINO和MultiMAE）进行比较。我们发现，MultiMAE是一个出乎意料的强大开箱即用基线，即使对从未见过的模态也能有效迁移，而我们针对性的修改在多传感器迁移和整体鲁棒性上带来了渐进但一致的改进。
